s.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or conver
t a repo's test files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validate
d together and reported individually: a `failed…\n- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, gener
ates cases against them, and persists them — the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persis
t, disconnect, respond.\n- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-f
rom-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of som
ething a person already wrote — a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into
full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the…\n- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this
after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts in
to the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back
under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delet
e an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past run
s that executed it are not affected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.
md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging in
to it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run a
rtifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested
run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is what `r
eportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT
_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its by
tes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authentic
ated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabiliti
es.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authoriza
tion as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting
transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a comple
ted eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-r
un variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint
a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-in
ference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credi
ts, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model leas
e](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in
the addressed project, immediately — the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so
this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open inge
stion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes it
s rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/sta
rt`.\n- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-st
art.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login
bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent,
not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports a
s it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eva
l-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not onl
y to those who can grant one — a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visible waiver.\n- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT ma
ke the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and every surface that honors it — the GitHu
b Check Run and the CLI's `eval gate` — reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and unti…\n- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting the gate and the GitHub Check Run back.
Requires the manage tier.\n- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a term
inal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation obj
ect with the unchanged draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…\n- [Read
the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceili
ng on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billing wind
ow, and how much of it has been spent.\n- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-proj
ects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends — the `suiteId`s the eval-run rout
es take.\n- [Search or list unified sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/search-or-list-unified-sessions.md): T
he unified, cross-surface sessions feed for one project: Playground, user-testing, eval, and swarm transcripts in one list, newest
first. Project-NESTED (unlike `/chat-sessions`) because `projectId` owns the scope here rather than filtering it.\n- [List a proj
ect's clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/list-a-projects-clients.md): The clients saved in the project — the n
